arxiv-1806-04080.title: On the Hardness of Satisfiability with Bounded Occurrences in the Polynomial-Time Hierarchy
arxiv-1806-04080.creator: Ishay Haviv, Oded Regev, Amnon Ta-Shma
arxiv-1806-04080.description: Abstract In 1991, Papadimitriou and Yannakakis gave a reduction implying the 𝖭𝖯 \mathsf{NP} -hardness of approximating the problem 3 ​ - ​ 𝖲𝖠𝖳 \rm{3}{\mbox{\raisebox{1.00006pt}{-}}}\mathsf{SAT} with bounded occurrences. Their reduction is based on expander graphs. We present an analogue of this result for the second level of the polynomial-time hierarchy based on superconcentrator graphs.

arxiv-1812-04090.title: Relational Cost Analysis for Functional-Imperative Programs DOI: 10.1145/3341696 Journal: PACMPL Volume: 3 ICFP 92 8 CCS: Theory of computation Type structures CCS: Theory of computation Program verification
arxiv-1812-04090.creator: Weihao Qu, Marco Gaboardi, Deepak Garg
arxiv-1812-04090.description: Abstract . Relational cost analysis aims at formally establishing bounds on the difference in the evaluation costs of two programs. As a particular case, one can also use relational cost analysis to establish bounds on the difference in the evaluation cost of the same program on two different inputs.

arxiv-2110-15111.title: Prospects in the search for a new light Z ′ Z^{\prime} boson with the NA64 μ \mu experiment at the CERN SPS
arxiv-2110-15111.creator: H. Sieber, D. Banerjee, P. Crivelli, E. Depero, S. N. Gninenko, D. V. Kirpichnikov, M. M. Kirsanov, V. Poliakov, L. Molina Bueno
arxiv-2110-15111.description: Abstract A light Z ′ Z^{\prime} vector boson coupled to the second and third lepton generations through L μ − L τ L_{\mu}-L_{\tau} current with mass below 200 MeV provides a very viable explanation in terms of new physics to the recently confirmed ( g − 2 ) μ (g-2)_{\mu} anomaly.

arxiv-2212-00732.title: An improved synthetic signal injection routine for the Haloscope At Yale Sensitive To Axion Cold dark matter (HAYSTAC)
arxiv-2212-00732.creator: Yuqi Zhu, M. J. Jewell, Claire Laffan, Xiran Bai, Sumita Ghosh, Eleanor Graham, S. B. Cahn, Reina H. Maruyama, S. K. Lamoreaux
arxiv-2212-00732.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yuqi Zhu, M. J. Jewell, Claire Laffan, Xiran Bai, Sumita Ghosh, Eleanor Graham, S. B. Cahn, Reina H. Maruyama, S. K. Lamoreaux. Microwave cavity haloscopes are among the most sensitive direct detection experiments searching for dark matter axions via their coupling to photons. When the power of the expected microwave signal due to axion-photon conversion is on the order of 10 − 24 10^{-24} W, having the ability to validate the detector response and analysis procedure by injecting realistic synthetic axion signals becomes helpful.

arxiv-2403-15712.title: PNAS-MOT: Multi-Modal Object Tracking with Pareto Neural Architecture Search Thanks: Nanyang Ye is the corresponding author.
arxiv-2403-15712.creator: Chensheng Peng, Zhaoyu Zeng, Jinling Gao, Jundong Zhou, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Xinbing Wang, Chenghu Zhou, Nanyang Ye
arxiv-2403-15712.description: Abstract Multiple object tracking is a critical task in autonomous driving. Existing works primarily focus on the heuristic design of neural networks to obtain high accuracy. As tracking accuracy improves, however, neural networks become increasingly complex, posing challenges for their practical application in real driving scenarios due to the high level of latency.

arxiv-2504-18160.title: Offline Learning of Controllable Diverse Behaviors
arxiv-2504-18160.creator: Mathieu Petitbois, Rémy Portelas, Sylvain Lamprier, Ludovic Denoyer
arxiv-2504-18160.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mathieu Petitbois, Rémy Portelas, Sylvain Lamprier, Ludovic Denoyer. Imitation Learning (IL) techniques aim to replicate human behaviors in specific tasks. While IL has gained prominence due to its effectiveness and efficiency, traditional methods often focus on datasets collected from experts to produce a single efficient policy. Recently, extensions have been proposed to handle datasets of diverse behaviors by mainly focusing on learning transition-level diverse policies or on performing entropy maximization at the trajectory level.

arxiv-2601-10009.title: Möbius-Type Structures in Non-Orientable Singular Semi-Riemannian Manifolds
arxiv-2601-10009.creator: Nathalie E. Rieger
arxiv-2601-10009.description: Abstract . Our objective is to illuminate the global structure of non-orientable manifolds with signature-changing metrics. Using explicit constructions based on the topology of the Möbius strip, we produce examples of crosscap manifolds where the gluing junction serves as the locus of signature change. In another set of examples, we convert the Möbius strip into a singular signature-type changing manifold.

pmc-11508038.title: Health-Related Quality of Life of Adolescents With Non-transfusion-Dependent Thalassemia in Basrah, Iraq
pmc-11508038.creator: Zahraa M Hameed, Meaad K Hassan, Bahaa A Ahmed
pmc-11508038.description: Background: Thalassemia is a chronic inherited disease with the potential for serious clinical and psychological effects. In the case of thalassemia, a cure is not currently accessible, and lifelong treatment is required. Health-related quality of life (HRQoL) is considered a crucial health outcome.

pmc-11538969.title: Takotsubo syndrome induced by de novo left bundle branch area pacing: a case report
pmc-11538969.creator: Chokanan Thaitirarot, Shirley Sze, Ahmed Hafez, Raj Rajendra, Mokhtar Ibrahim
pmc-11538969.description: BackgroundTakotsubo syndrome (TS), traditionally associated with emotional or physical stressors, manifests as transient left ventricular (LV) abnormalities mimicking acute coronary syndrome. Surgical procedures, such as pacemaker implantation, have emerged as potential TS triggers. Conduction system pacing (CSP), including His bundle pacing and left bundle branch area pacing (LBBAP), is a novel technique utilizing the heart's intrinsic conduction system.

uslaw-usc-t16-s4409.title: 16 U.S.C. § 4409 — Report to Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s4409.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s4409.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 64 (North American Wetlands Conservation). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary shall report to the appropriate Committees on the implementation of this chapter. The report shall include— (1) a biennial assessment of— (A) the estimated number of acres of wetlands and habitat for waterfowl and other migratory birds that were restored, protected, or enhanced.
